scope: Frozen HK Top100 retrospective candidate contract review; read-only source and evidence review.

verdict.split_date_schema_gap: NOT_THE_BLOCKER_FOR_20261008_SIGNAL_TO_20261009_TARGET; existing validators support explicit split-date provenance
verdict.name_fields: DISPLAY_METADATA_GAP; not eligibility evidence, but strict publisher rejects placeholders

findings.title: The candidate cannot enter the current authoritative HK Stage D-1 path as WATCH_ONLY without changing the contract.
evidence: stage_center/_runner_parts/hk_input_validation.py:67-86 requires canonical target/stage eligibility, status STRICT_0_2_READY, false safety flags, and exactly 100 rows.
stage_center/_runner_parts/hk_input_validation.py:168-201 binds source role SHARED_VERIFIED_HK_0_2 and validates split-date provenance when dates differ.
stage_center/selection.py:89-93 names exact-date STRICT_0_2_READY Top100 as the HK selection membership contract.

upstreams/v3_shared_data/shared_data/hk_0_2.py:1051-1085 requires strict semantics, no cannot_confirm, complete non-placeholder names, and a verified security-master capture on the eligibility source date.
Candidate receipt says publication NOT_ATTEMPTED because no verified 20261008 security-master capture exists; eligibility remains reconstructed/PIT-unverified.
findings.impact: A WATCH_ONLY label and false trade-safety flags do not grant Stage eligibility. Marking this incomplete candidate stage_selection_eligible=true or STRICT_0_2_READY would erase the known epistemic boundary. It may remain a separate research candidate with its caveats, but the current Stage replay consumer must reject it.

findings.title: The scorer's row defaults do not preserve the candidate's known gaps unless the envelope carries them.
evidence: upstreams/v3_shared_data/shared_data/hk_0_2.py:1028-1037 labels rows WATCH_ONLY and production_allowed=false, but also sets cannot_confirm to an empty string and d1_freshness_status to PASS.
Candidate receipt lines 4-8 and 45-90 preserve PIT uncertainty, three missing signal-session bars, three Top100 missing pre_close values, and 17 missing names at the candidate-receipt level.
findings.impact: A downstream candidate artifact must carry the receipt's uncertainty and missingness in its envelope/provenance and must not treat scorer row defaults as proof that the gaps are absent. No code in the reviewed candidate was changed.

field_assessment.eligibility_and_pit: Material gap: eligibility set is retrospective reconstructed candidate; PIT is unverified. The candidate's 100 rows are scores among observed signal-session panel members; three of 698 eligible codes lack that session bar, so completeness of Top100 versus all eligible codes CANNOT_CONFIRM.
field_assessment.prices: Material gaps: three eligible codes have no 20261008 signal-session bar and three Top100 rows lack pre_close. No 20261009 substitution occurred. Their effect on candidate ranking/tradability is CANNOT_CONFIRM.
field_assessment.names: Seventeen Top100 names are blank. Names are observable metadata and cannot validate membership; the existing strict publisher separately rejects missing/name-code placeholders.
field_assessment.market_cap: The inspected _OUTPUT_FIELDS and scorer/publisher/Stage membership path do not require or consume market_cap; its absence is not a demonstrated blocker for this current contract. Any separate user-facing requirement is CANNOT_CONFIRM.

compatibility_analysis.pool_store: PreselectionPoolStore has optional target_date, signal_date, stage_selection_eligible, historical_provenance and a cannot_confirm list; historical provenance v2 and split-date v1 are modeled. This does not make a WATCH_ONLY artifact Stage-eligible.
compatibility_analysis.producer: score_frozen_hk_0_2 accepts an eligible-code set, but materialize_frozen_hk_0_2 loads that set from the verified security master, then calls the strict publisher. The publisher rejects known gaps and requires the verified capture.
compatibility_analysis.stage_research_replay: The existing historical observation route produces WATCH_ONLY/NO_BUY rows from a manifest-bound after-fact observation and can be invoked for historical stage/date tuples, but it still starts from _build_hk_d1_binding, whose exact D-1 input must satisfy the strict 0.2 status/eligibility contract. The explicit 0930 pinned exceptions are date/hash-bound; the generic manifest-bound observation path does not relax the D-1 pool contract.

test_evidence.assertion_observation: pytest emitted one passing-test dot before shutdown
test_evidence.failure: pytest cleanup raised PermissionError while deleting a pytest-owned temporary directory containing read-only runtime_graph/snapshots files; full test-process PASS CANNOT_CONFIRM.
test_evidence.interpretation: This existing test demonstrates WATCH_ONLY/NO_BUY for a manifest-bound after-fact raw observation, not acceptance of a WATCH_ONLY D-1 pool as Stage preselection.

p1: Candidate cannot be consumed as current authoritative Stage D-1 preselection without a distinct explicit research-only contract; do not promote it to STRICT_0_2_READY or stage_selection_eligible=true.
p2: Candidate receipt gaps are not reflected in scorer row cannot_confirm/freshness defaults unless a downstream envelope preserves them.
